definitions.explanation: A private school offering supplementary education, often for exam preparation.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{塾|じゅく}に{通|かよ}わせている。
examples.english: I'm sending my child to cram school.

examples.japanese: {塾|じゅく}で{数学|すうがく}を{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: I'm studying math at cram school.

examples.japanese: {受験|じゅけん}のために{塾|じゅく}に{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started going to cram school for exam preparation.

notes:
TYPES OF {塾|じゅく}:
- {学習|がくしゅう}{塾|じゅく} (general study cram school)
- {進学|しんがく}{塾|じゅく} (exam prep cram school)
- {補習|ほしゅう}{塾|じゅく} (supplementary tutoring)
- {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}{塾|じゅく} (individual tutoring school)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塾|じゅく}に{通|かよ}う (to attend cram school)
- {塾|じゅく}に{行|い}く (to go to cram school)
- {塾|じゅく}の{先生|せんせい} (cram school teacher)
- {塾|じゅく}{代|だい} (cram school fees)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {予備校|よびこう} (prep school - for university entrance)
- {家庭教師|かていきょうし} (private tutor)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{塾|じゅく} is integral to Japanese education. Many students attend after regular school hours to prepare for entrance exams or supplement school learning. The industry is significant, and famous {塾|じゅく} brands are well-known.
